scope.encoder: jointly trained affine+tanh; encoder pretraining deferred
scope.training: full episode BPTT, exact paired balanced arms, deterministic horizon cycle
scope.selection: minimum mean loss across fixed balanced validation horizons; ties keep earlier checkpoint
scope.measurements: finite-time pre-query complete-state clouds and held-out standardized linear ridge probes; no Floquet or tangent claim
scope.limitations: one fixed learning rate and three diagnostic seeds; no causal interventions or native transfer; this is engineering readiness, not scientific acceptance
